ShortDescription.Value: Build multiple Unique buildings without excessive Signature bonuses. Keep your economy balanced, or use vanilla effects.

Publish.LongDescription:
## Realistic Signature Buildings
**Build the city you want, without making its economy unrealistically easy.**
Want to place several copies of a beautiful Unique or Signature building? In the vanilla game, extra Signature buildings with city-wide bonuses can stack those bonuses, giving your city more advantages than you intended.
**Realistic Signature Buildings lets you build freely while keeping bonuses under control.** Use each bonus once per building type, turn bonuses off, or keep the original stacked effects. You decide how realistic or flexible your city should be.
### City-wide Signature bonuses **Default: First copy only** - **First copy only:** Each Signature building type gives its city-wide bonus just once. Duplicate copies can still be built for their appearance without multiplying that bonus. - **No city-wide bonuses:** Disable Signature buildings' city-wide bonuses. - **Vanilla Stacked Bonuses:** Keep the original game behavior. Every eligible copy contributes its city-wide bonus.
### Nearby Signature effects **Default: Vanilla nearby effects** - **Vanilla nearby effects:** Keep normal local effects from every copy. - **First copy only:** Only one copy of each Signature type provides nearby effects. - **No nearby effects:** Remove normal local effects from Signature buildings.
Both controls work independently. Building attractiveness and abandoned-building penalties are preserved.
### More freedom, without the unintended bonus stacking - **Allow multiple copies of Unique buildings**, including Signature buildings. Default: ON. - **Unlock Signature requirements:** Make Signature buildings available without meeting population, zoning, building-count, or other progression requirements. Default: OFF. - Bulk Signature unlocking does not trigger a flood of new-building popups. - Existing buildings stay placed if you restore one-per-city placement rules. - Change bonus modes in Options without restarting your city. - View Signature building totals, duplicate counts, and active city-wide bonus providers in Status. - Use **Bonus Report to log** and **Nearby Report to log** for diagnostics that restore your selected modes.
### Compatibility and notes - Compatible with Anarchy's Multiple Unique setting. Other mods that allow unlimited Unique buildings are redundant. - No Harmony patches or required third-party mod dependencies. - Works with existing cities. Back up your save before changing your mod setup. - Some Signature buildings have only nearby effects, only city-wide effects, or neither. Controls affect only the effects each building actually provides. - Hover over Options settings for details. Use Options > About > Debug / Logging > Open Log to see reports.
